### 2026-10-06 – Um.... I was using lapse in the lookout app and i pressed start lapse, but forgot to select monitor so it didnt start. I progressed on my pcb, adding the ES8388 module and starting on all of its conne

**1.2h**

Um.... I was using lapse in the lookout app and i pressed start lapse, but forgot to select monitor so it didnt start. I progressed on my pcb, adding the ES8388 module and starting on all of its connections. I've been using labels instead of wires cause its so much cleaner in KiCad. Next step is to continue adding the resistors capacitors etc, and then I'll work on the TFT screen and then actually make the PCB (Im doing the schema right now)
